title: Aries and Libra, Leo and Aquarius (2026-10-23)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
1. what do we mean by versioning? 
Aries would promote new versions. Action.    Libra is reference and stability

2. Aquarius vs leo 
Leo again promotes motion forward. Driven from the centre. 
Aquarius proposes wider change - but aligned with the group. So it's slower. 

Leo's change is noticable but bound. 
Aquarius is deeper, but open
